records.title: Signature mismatch: viteFinal
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `viteFinal` from `viteFinal: PresetProperty<'viteFinal'> = async (config, options) => { ... }` to `export const viteFinal = async (config: any, options: Options) => { ...; return { ...config, plugins: [...] } } (no declared type; return type inferred)`, the signature the source defines at `code/addons/docs/src/preset.ts:159`.
records.issue: documented `viteFinal: PresetProperty<'viteFinal'> = async (config, options) => { ... }`, source `export const viteFinal = async (config: any, options: Options) => { ...; return { ...config, plugins: [...] } } (no declared type; return type inferred)`: declared type: the documented `PresetProperty<'viteFinal'>` is not the type of this declaration (unannotated, `config: any, options: Options`), and since StorybookConfigRaw has no `viteFinal` key it resolves to a function taking `config: never` and returning `never | Promise<never>`, so parameter and return types differ

records.title: Signature mismatch: useParameter
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `useParameter` from `useParameter(key, default)` to `useParameter<S>(parameterKey: string, defaultValue?: S): S | undefined`, the signature the source defines at `code/core/src/preview-api/modules/addons/hooks.ts:590`.
records.issue: documented `useParameter(key, default)`, source `useParameter<S>(parameterKey: string, defaultValue?: S): S | undefined`: parameter names differ ('key' vs 'parameterKey', 'default' vs 'defaultValue') and the second parameter is optional in the source ('defaultValue?') while the documented 'default' is shown without '?'

records.title: Signature mismatch: setProjectAnnotations
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `setProjectAnnotations` from `setProjectAnnotations(projectAnnotations: NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<any> | NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<any>[]): NormalizedProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>` to `setProjectAnnotations<TRenderer extends Renderer = Renderer>(projectAnnotations: NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<TRenderer> | NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>[]): NormalizedProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>`, the signature the source defines at `code/core/src/preview-api/modules/store/csf/portable-stories.ts:73`.
records.issue: documented `setProjectAnnotations(projectAnnotations: NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<any> | NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<any>[]): NormalizedProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>`, source `setProjectAnnotations<TRenderer extends Renderer = Renderer>(projectAnnotations: NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<TRenderer> | NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>[]): NormalizedProjectAnnotations<TRenderer>`: type of 'projectAnnotations': NamedOrDefaultProjectAnnotations<TRenderer> (generic) vs <any>; return type NormalizedProjectAnnotations<TRenderer> vs NormalizedProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>

records.title: Signature mismatch: composeStories
records.remediation: Update the documented signature of `composeStories` from `composeStories<TModule extends Store_CSFExports<ReactRenderer, any>>(csfExports: TModule, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>): Omit<StoriesWithPartialProps<ReactRenderer, TModule>, keyof Store_CSFExports>` to `composeStories<TModule extends Store_CSFExports>(storiesImport: TModule, globalConfig: ProjectAnnotations<Renderer>, composeStoryFn: ComposeStoryFn = defaultComposeStory) (return type not annotated)`, the signature the source defines at `code/core/src/preview-api/modules/store/csf/portable-stories.ts:274`.
records.issue: documented `composeStories<TModule extends Store_CSFExports<ReactRenderer, any>>(csfExports: TModule, projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>): Omit<StoriesWithPartialProps<ReactRenderer, TModule>, keyof Store_CSFExports>`, source `composeStories<TModule extends Store_CSFExports>(storiesImport: TModule, globalConfig: ProjectAnnotations<Renderer>, composeStoryFn: ComposeStoryFn = defaultComposeStory) (return type not annotated)`: first parameter named 'csfExports' vs 'storiesImport'; second parameter is the required 'globalConfig: ProjectAnnotations<Renderer>' in the source, documented as optional 'projectAnnotations?: ProjectAnnotations<ReactRenderer>'; missing optional parameter 'composeStoryFn'; documented return type Omit<StoriesWithPartialProps<ReactRenderer, TModule>, keyof Store_CSFExports> vs not annotated
